description: Searches WarmInboxes' own catalogue of about 1,000 free B2B lead lists, by industry, role and country, as published at https://warminboxes.com/leads. It does not search the web or any other database. Returns the best-matching lists with lead counts, verified email counts and each list's page. Lists are emailed to the person from that page; this tool cannot request or download a list.

category.description: Optional category to narrow to, e.g. "Accountants". Call with no query to get the category list.

limit.description: How many matches, 1 to 10. Defaults to 3.

query.description: What they want, in plain words: an industry, role or country, e.g. "SaaS founders UK" or "dentists".

name: find_lead_lists
title: Free B2B lead lists (WarmInboxes catalogue)
